name: IC Interface — I2C, SPI, 3.6V — TSSOP
description: Cluster of 2 SMD IC interface parts supporting I2C, SPI, and 3.6V operation in a TSSOP-16 footprint.
selection_hints: Select when requiring an SMD IC interface component supporting I2C and SPI at 3.6V.
Use when the PCB layout requires a TSSOP-16 (4.4x5mm, 0.65mm pitch) footprint.
Choose between Tier A representative parts SC18IS604PW and SC18IS606PW.
avoid_when: The board layout requires a package family or footprint other than TSSOP-16.
Through-hole mounting is required instead of surface mount (SMD).
Operating requirements fall outside of I2C, SPI, or 3.6V facets.
